process_en: Carburizing and heat treatment of carburizing steels
process_tr: Sementasyon çeliklerinin sementasyonu ve ısıl işlemi
key_values: case 0.5-0.7 mm (gears), 1.0-1.5 mm (pins); core >= 30 HRC; sub-zero; double temper

applies_to: ring gear; quill splines, transfer sleeve
key_values: >= 650 HV surface (ring); depth 0.5-0.7 mm (ring); white layer <= 10 um

process_en: Heat treatment of low-alloy steel parts
process_tr: Düşük alaşımlı çelik parçaların ısıl işlemi

applies_to: gear roots and fillets (flanks masked), carrier fillets, quill necks
key_values: cast steel shot, intensity 0.008-0.012 A on gears, 0.010-0.014 A on the carrier, coverage 200% (TBR)

process_tr: Dişli taşlama ve diş yüzeyi düzeltmeleri
key_values: tip relief, helix correction and crowning of step 2.4 on the drawings

applies_to: all ground carburized and nitrided surfaces
key_values: class to the drawing (no rehardening, limited tempering on the flanks)

applies_to: all gear flanks; planet bore raceway
key_values: Ra <= 0.15 um, Rz <= 0.8 um (STR-09); the step 2.4 ratings and films use Rz 0.8 (external) and Rz 1.0 (ring): film ratio at the pitch point with Type II at 100 degC: first stage 1.54, sun-planet 0.53, planet-ring 0.85

applies_to: A357 castings, Ti and CRES parts

key_values: P101: every casting after HIP of the whole casting; critical zones (R10 flange junction, nose, mount flange and pads, zone note on the 3.9 drawing) at a 0.5 mm pore limit by CT (preferred) or radiography at quality level 1-2T or better (ASTM E1742 with E1025 IQIs; POD of 0.5 mm demonstrated, 90/95), elsewhere 100% radiography at 0.8 mm; other castings: grade B critical zones, grade C elsewhere, 100% on first articles, then by sampling (TBR, STR-10)

process_en: Ultrasonic inspection of forgings and bar
applies_to: carrier forging, gear forgings, Ti bar and forgings
key_values: class AA for the carrier and the retention tube (TBR)

process_en: Conversion coating and paint of aluminium
key_values: outside: coat + primer + topcoat; inside: coat only

process_en: Proof pressure test of oil passages and lines
process_tr: Yağ kanalları ve hatlarının basınç testi
key_values: 1650 kPa for 3 min, no leak (1.5 x the 1100 kPa relief, TBR)

process_en: Fire test of oil-carrying external parts
process_tr: Yağ taşıyan dış parçaların yangın testi
applies_to: case and cover walls, external tubes and hoses, tank
key_values: fire resistant: 5 min, 1100 degC flame; tank fireproof: 15 min (SAF-05); by test in 3.11
